functions.description: Creates an Excel Entity card or value from JSON, XML, array text, or a range.
functions.name: NEW

parameters.description: Raw JSON, XML, array literal string, or cell range.
parameters.name: input

parameters.description: Optional text displayed in the cell next to the entity icon.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: If true, uses first column (2 cols) or first row (>2 cols) as keys. Default is false.
parameters.name: headers

functions.description: Extracts a nested value by dot/bracket path from an Entity or raw input.
functions.name: GET

parameters.description: Entity cell or raw data input.
parameters.name: source

functions.description: Returns the keys or indices of an Entity or object.
functions.name: KEYS

parameters.description: Entity cell or raw data input.
parameters.name: source

parameters.description: If true (default), spills vertically. If false, wraps in an additional array level.
parameters.name: spill

functions.description: Flattens an Entity, object, or array into a tabular grid up to a specified depth.
functions.name: FLATTEN

parameters.description: Entity cell or raw data input.
parameters.name: source

parameters.description: Value to fill sibling columns in child rows (default null copies parent row values).
parameters.name: pad_value

parameters.description: Nesting depth to expand (default 1; deeper values stay as Entities).
parameters.name: levels
